title: Babu Lal v. Hazari Lal Kishori Lal

content.caseIdentity: Babu Lal v. Hazari Lal Kishori Lal, (1982) 1 SCC 525
content.holding: The executing court has plenary jurisdiction to grant actual possession of property in execution of a decree for specific performance under Section 28(3) of the Specific Relief Act.
content.relevance: Scope of executing court powers in specific performance decrees.
